visual_elements.description: Dark red/maroon rectangular border framing the entire slide content.

Small line plot titled f(x)=1/(1+e^-x). Red sigmoid curve; x-axis ticks -6, -4, -2, 0, 2, 4, 6; y-axis ticks 0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1; legend entry 'sigmoid'; curve passes through (0,0.5) and saturates near 0 and 1.
Small neuron-style diagram: blue circle labeled Σ, black arrow labeled Net pointing right into a small box containing a red sigmoid-curve icon.
visual_elements.position: top-center/left, just to the right of the O_j definition

Tan/orange rounded box at bottom-right containing the final result, preceded by =>.
Blue curved arrow pointing from the fourth derivation box to the final result box.
visual_elements.position: between the fourth equation and the final box

visual_elements.description: Yellow circle with black number 4 at the top-right corner.

imagery: Small red sigmoid-curve icon inside the activation box of the Σ → Net diagram; simple line-art style, top-center.
typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout. Title is bold and larger; 'Remember:' is italic blue while 'Derivative of Sigmoid Function' is dark red. Equations use math-style formatting with subscripts; Net_j and isolated -1 terms are blue; final O_j is dark red. Slide number is plain black text in a yellow circle.
animation_state: Static; all derivation steps and the final result are visible, with no mid-build indication.
recreation_brief: Set the slide background to light gray (#F2F2F2) and add a dark red (#A62323) rectangular outline near the slide edges.
Add a title text box at the top-left: 'Remember: ' in italic blue (#1F4FD8) followed by 'Derivative of Sigmoid Function' in bold dark red (#B02418); use a large sans-serif size such as 32 pt.

At the top-right, insert a small line chart titled f(x)=1/(1+e^-x). Plot a red sigmoid curve, set x ticks to -6, -4, -2, 0, 2, 4, 6 and y ticks to 0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1, and add a legend entry 'sigmoid'.
Add a yellow (#FFFF00) circle at the far top-right with black text '4'.
Below the title on the left, place the definition equation: O_j = f(Net_j) = 1/(1+e^-Net_j).
To the right of that definition, draw a small blue-outlined circle containing Σ, a black arrow labeled Net pointing right, and a small white box containing a red sigmoid-curve icon.

Add four stacked white boxes with thin gray borders down the center-left. Inside them place, in order: f'(Net_j)=((1+e^-Net_j)*e^-Net_j)/((1+e^-Net_j)(1+e^-Net_j))=(1*(1+e^-Net_j)-1)/((1+e^-Net_j)(1+e^-Net_j)); f'(Net_j)=1/(1+e^-Net_j) * ((1+e^-Net_j)-1)/(1+e^-Net_j); =1/(1+e^-Net_j) * ((1+e^-Net_j)/(1+e^-Net_j) - 1/(1+e^-Net_j)); f'(Net_j)=1/(1+e^-Net_j) * [1 - 1/(1+e^-Net_j)]. Keep Net_j and the -1 terms blue where shown.
Add a blue curved arrow from the fourth equation box to a tan/orange (#F5D0A9) rounded box at the bottom-right. Inside that box place '=> f'(Net_j)=O_j(1-O_j)', with O_j in dark red (#C00000).
